summary: Added lib/backlog.mjs (pure exports STATUSES, parseRows, formatRows, validateProposals, mergeProposals, setStatus, orderRows, importRows, listLines; CLI merge/set/list/import/validate, atomic tmp+rename writes) and tests/checks/35-backlog-pure-m1.sh, 7 checks written first. Tests 395 → 402.
verified_how: Red first, before lib/backlog.mjs existed, all 7 failed: 'backlog merge: a new id becomes one proposed row first seen in its run', 'backlog merge: a known id adds its run to runs_seen once, status unchanged', 'backlog validate: bad JSON, a missing id or a non-slug id exits 1 with one line, rows unchanged', 'backlog set: specced --spec flips the status and records the spec; an unknown id or status exits 1', 'backlog list: proposed first, then more runs_seen first within a status', 'backlog import: 8 rows into an empty store, then again 8 (idempotent by id)', 'backlog import: a known id takes status, spec, pr and note, keeps first_seen, unions runs_seen'. Then 7/7 (bash tests/run.sh 35-backlog); full suite via lib/check.sh green, 402 tests, conformance passing; node --check lib/backlog.mjs.

dead_ends.tried: the list check reading the same store the set check edited
dead_ends.why: set leaves bb-once with a spec, so the line lengths and --max-bytes cut changed; the list check now reads an untouched copy (four.jsonl)

discoveries.text: CLI output channels: merge's ok and invalid lines and validate's why line go to stdout (the driver notes `$(node lib/backlog.mjs merge …)`); set/import/usage errors go to stderr as one `backlog: <why>` line, exit 1 (usage: exit 2 for an unknown command). set on a missing store exits 1 (unknown id) and writes nothing.

list --max-bytes is a hard cap including the `… (<n> more rows)` line; list --jsonl --max-bytes stops at whole rows with no trailer. import of a known id sets spec/pr/note to the import row's values (null when absent), keeps title and first_seen; a new import row needs a title, a slug id and one of the five statuses.
